hero.mascotAlt: Bindy, the Binder shiba, happily showing off a trading card

bilingual.label: Bilingual day one
bilingual.sub: Every string flips — including the tab bar.

launch.label: Running now
launch.sub: Hong Kong collectors are testing it. Apply below for access.

features.title: Built for how Hong Kong actually trades.

pairs.title: Every post is a pair.
pairs.body: Forcing a 'want' surfaces liquidity a one-sided feed can't see.

matching.title: Find the exact counterpart.
matching.body: Say what you have and what you want. Binder surfaces the traders whose wants mirror yours — exact card matches first, close ones after.

offers.title: Offers, not haggling.
offers.body: Send a structured offer inside the chat: cards on both sides, cash to balance. Accept, counter or decline in one tap.

waitlist.title: Be there on launch day.
waitlist.body: A small group of Hong Kong collectors, selected from the waitlist, get early access. First-come, first-served.
waitlist.micro: No spam. One email when we open. Unsubscribe whenever.
waitlist.mascotAlt: Bindy the shiba proudly holding up a sparkling card

notFound.lede: Bindy checked every pocket — this page isn't in the binder.
notFound.mascotAlt: Bindy the shiba sadly hugging an empty binder
